cli.agents.title: What you can do
cli.agents.text: Drive SpecGuard from a coding agent through the MCP server, hooks and skills, or from CI through the action.

dashboard.activity.title: Activity tab
dashboard.activity.text: A local log of what the extension ran, with output, status and duration.

dashboard.coverage.title: Coverage tab
dashboard.coverage.text: Spec coverage (source files a spec owns) and test coverage (owned files whose capability has tests).

dashboard.docs.title: Docs tab
dashboard.docs.text: Generated documentation for this repository, and the way into the SpecGuard docs.

dashboard.findings.title: Findings tab
dashboard.findings.text: Code-quality and security findings, filterable by severity, with links to the file and line.

dashboard.flow.title: Actions tab
dashboard.flow.text: The pipeline as steps you can run in order: create specs, generate and run tests, scan, generate docs.

dashboard.overview.title: Overview tab
dashboard.overview.text: Spec health for this repository at a glance, with the next step when no specs exist yet.

dashboard.plans.title: Plans tab
dashboard.plans.text: Implementation plans from gap analysis, each with a status so you and an agent share one list of what is left.

dashboard.settings.title: Settings tab
dashboard.settings.text: Per-repository overrides of the model provider and team server; keys stay in secret storage.

dashboard.specs.title: Specs tab
dashboard.specs.text: Every spec with the files and tests it owns; organize them into groups for presentation.

dashboard.tests.title: Tests tab
dashboard.tests.text: The test files found in the configured test sources and the latest run.

dashboard.traceability.title: Traceability tab
dashboard.traceability.text: Each claim with the tests that carry its tag and its proof state.

docs.build.title: What to expect
docs.build.text: Documentation pages are built from the specs; after you change a spec, run `specguard docs build` and commit the result.

plugins.about.title: Why it exists
plugins.about.text: Plugins add commands, contract importers, detectors and documentation renderers without changing core.

sidebar.coverage.title: Coverage view
sidebar.coverage.text: Capabilities with their claim, test and proof counts; select one to open its spec.

sidebar.pipelines.title: Pipelines view
sidebar.pipelines.text: The actions you can run, limited to those of enabled plugins, plus each plugin's own commands.

sidebar.plugins.title: Plugins view
sidebar.plugins.text: Built-in and npm plugins, on or off; enable, disable, add or remove them here.

workspace.about.title: Why it exists
workspace.about.text: What a workspace is: several repositories or packages treated as one system, with ignored repos left out.

workspace.contracts.title: Contracts in the workspace dashboard
workspace.contracts.text: Edges and nodes of the contract graph and how many have gone unverified for more than 30 days; build or rebuild it here.

workspace.drift.title: Cross-repo drift
workspace.drift.text: Checks every repository for spec drift through the contract edges.

workspace.ignore.title: What you can do
workspace.ignore.text: Ignore a repository to leave it out of contracts, drift, security, proofs and the rollup.

workspace.repos.title: Repos in the workspace
workspace.repos.text: One card per repository with its role, capabilities, claims proven and a link to its dashboard.

workspace.settings.title: Workspace settings
workspace.settings.text: Defaults every repository inherits: provider, model, server and project mapping.

workspace.status.title: Workspace status
workspace.status.text: Repos specced, current specs, contract edges and ignored repos, with refresh and report actions.

workspace.teamServer.title: Team server in the workspace
workspace.teamServer.text: Whether this workspace is connected to a team server and what was last published.
